name: Windfury Totem
tooltip:
Windfury Totem
250 Mana
Instant
Requires Shaman
Requires level 52
Tools:
Air Totem
Summons a Windfury Totem with 5 health at the feet of the caster. The totem enhances the melee attacks of all party members within 30 yards. Each main hand hit has a 20% chance of granting the attacker 1 extra attack with (246 * 1) extra melee attack power. Lasts 5 min.
